<p>The Space PY26.2 TACFI NOO is operating on a continuous, rolling submission. Guidance is now publicly available. Proposal templates can be accessed through your government partners via the PY26.2 TACFI DAF Notice of Opportunity Teams channel. Please coordinate with your government counterparts to obtain all required materials.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Submission and guidance documents are <a class="clickable-parent" style="color: white; text-decoration: underline;" href="#resources">available in the “Resources” section below</a></p>
</div></div><div class="brxe-text"><p>The Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI) and Tactical Funding Increase (TACFI) program catalyze the relationships between the United States Space Force (USSF), private-sector innovators, and investors. These programs bridge the capability gap between current SBIR/STTR Phase II efforts and Phase III scaling efforts, facilitating the delivery of strategic capabilities for the USSF.</p>
<p>In 2023, the SpaceWERX team invested $72M in its strategic and tactical funding increase matching program. The matching program provided additional development reach for both dual use and military specific technologies. The program by capturing the outside investments stretched that investment to over $125M benefit across 14 promising technologies programs to accelerate these war winning technologies to the field and into the hands of our guardians. Our program is designed to mature technology through additional investments to mature technology by utilizing small business ingenuity to get after national space needs.</p>
<p>SpaceWERX awarded 142 space-focused contracts through the technology-agnostic Open Topic Phase II Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) program in 2023. These awards, reflecting SpaceWERX’s dedication to fostering technology excellence, boast a projected value of $151 million. The breadth of research and development work being conducted underscores our pivotal role in shaping the future of the industry.</p>

Watches the search form

    -(this is a pretty broad method.  Could target it more by adding more specific classes, but all accordions include .brxe-block.listening tags, so it was easy)
- Searches the data attribute (data-tippy-content) because that's where the content for the tooltip is stored)

*/
jQuery(document).ready(function($){
  $("#searchForm").on("keyup", function() {
    // This adds the .brx-open class to the specified elements on keyup
    $('.brxe-block.listening').addClass('brx-open');
    
    var value = $(this).val().toLowerCase();

    $(".program-year-card").filter(function() {
      // Get the element's standard text content
      var cardText = $(this).text();
      
      // Get the content from the 'data-tippy-content' attribute. 
      // The `|| ''` prevents errors if the attribute doesn't exist.
      var tippyContent = $(this).attr('data-tippy-content') || '';
      
      // Combine the text and the attribute content into a single searchable string
      var searchableContent = (cardText + ' ' + tippyContent).toLowerCase();
      
      // Toggle visibility based on the combined content
      $(this).toggle(searchableContent.indexOf(value) > -1);
